name: claude-utils
description: Personal Claude Code utilities by Khoi (Kevin) Tran

plugins.name: pr-review-inline
plugins.description: Principal-engineer PR review posted back to the PR as inline comments — stack-detected Java/Spring and React/TypeScript checklists, deferring to the reviewed repo's own rules

plugins.name: implement-idea-full-cycle
plugins.description: Unattended idea-to-reviewed-PR cycle — delegates the ticket and implementation to a project skill, then reviews and fixes in two fresh contexts, verifying both against git instead of trusting their reports

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Explains one thing so a junior developer can follow it — summary, then context, concepts, challenges, solutions, and trade-offs at one to three sentences each, in plain language with every abbreviation spelled out
